text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Cesario takes 1st! It's Cesario!
Overcoming a field of formidable rivals,
Cesario ascends the throne as the new queen of an era!!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
Heh...
I told you, this is the one thing I won't yield on.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
However, to be completely honest...
...I felt in awe.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
*sniff*...!!
That was amazing! That was so, so amazing~...!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... Fufu,
come on, look, Cesario!!

text_block_list.name: Rhein Kraft
text_block_list.text:
...It's frustrating, but
you won today, after all!

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Indeed.
Thank you for the praise, Craft.

text_block_list.name: Cesario
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you so much!
Spe-san, Kris S-san!!

text_block_list.name: Air Messiah
text_block_list.text:
Haa, ngh...!!
Haa, haa, haa, haa...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...Winners and losers alike each have their own feelings.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, the "Oaks" came to a close
for Rhein Kraft and the others...
